title: Serenity Now
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘Marisol’ a Luxury 7 Bedroom, 7.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a private pool, rooftop terrace & 6-seater golf cart.
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Gulf Views - Easy Beach Access - Private heated pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Game Room - 6 seater Golf Cart and 6 adult Bikes - Elevator Located just moments from the sugar-white shoreline of Inlet Beach, this is a thoughtfully crafted coastal residence that seamlessly combines upscale design with relaxed seaside living. Recently completed by CM Taylor Constructing and styled by Erin Anthony Designs, this four-story home was designed with both comfort and versatility in mind, comfortably accommodating up to 20 guests which is ideal for large gatherings. The first level welcomes you with an expansive game room, four custom-built bunk beds, two full bathrooms, a laundry area, and direct access to a private outdoor retreat. This inviting space features a heated swimming pool, summer kitchen, outdoor fireplace, and professionally landscaped grounds, all conveniently positioned just steps from the neighborhood dune walkover. An elevator provides access to every floor. The main living level offers an open-concept layout with beautiful Gulf views and a chef-inspired kitchen equipped with Wolf appliances, an emerald tile backsplash, farmhouse sink, and a well-appointed butler’s pantry with ice maker. A Venetian plaster fireplace, statement lighting, and layered textures create a refined yet welcoming atmosphere throughout the living spaces. Two serene primary suites, each complete with luxurious en-suite bathrooms, serve as private escapes, while additional guest suites with their own baths ensure comfort and privacy for family and friends. The top floor reveals two rooftop terraces boasting sweeping, unobstructed Gulf views, an ideal setting for sunset gatherings and entertaining. Offering parking for up to seven vehicles, including a two-car garage and dedicated golf cart space, and positioned just steps from beach access. First Floor Bunk Room - Two Queen over Queen Bunks - Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Second Floor Master Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Half Bathroom Third Floor Master Bedroom - King Bed- Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Two Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Queen Bedroom (Office) - Private Bathroom with Shower Only
